description: This file defines a class 'DiGraph' implementing a simple unweighted directed graph data structure with methods for adding nodes and edges, traversing, and generating a dot representation. It appears to be part of a dependency tracking or graph analysis system.

classes.name: DiGraph
classes.description: A simple unweighted directed graph data structure for dependency tracking, with methods for adding nodes and edges, traversing, and generating visualizations.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the DiGraph with empty node, successor, predecessor dictionaries, and node order tracking.

methods.name: add_node
methods.description: Adds a node with optional attributes to the graph, updating existing node attributes if node already exists.

methods.name: add_edge
methods.description: Adds an edge between two nodes, creating nodes if they do not exist.

methods.name: successors
methods.description: Returns an iterator over successor nodes of a given node.

methods.name: predecessors
methods.description: Returns an iterator over predecessor nodes of a given node.

methods.name: edges
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all edges in the graph.

methods.name: nodes
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of all nodes with their attributes.

methods.name: __contains__
methods.description: Checks if a node exists in the graph.

methods.name: forward_transitive_closure
methods.description: Returns a set of nodes reachable from a source node.

methods.name: backward_transitive_closure
methods.description: Returns a set of nodes reachable in reverse direction from a source node.

methods.name: all_paths
methods.description: Returns a subgraph showing all paths from src to dst, in dot format.

methods.name: first_path
methods.description: Returns the first path leading to a destination node.

methods.name: to_dot
methods.description: Generates a dot format string representing the graph.
